_doc: Special images. 'file' is null until the art exists. Add entries as scenes are scripted.

CG-01.desc: Attic window at dusk: glowing Patch 7 in the distance, the crow on the sill

CG-02.desc: Lecture hall: Brad with a fire extinguisher in a cloud of foam, Patricia peering over her glasses, the crow in the window with his name tag

CG-03.desc: Science lab drowned in glowing orange foam, four silhouettes in goggles standing in it

CG-04a.desc: Bonfire, Jane leaning her head on Brad's shoulder, Best Float trophy on a hay bale

CG-04b.desc: Tavern rooftop: Sandra and Brad side by side, bonfire glowing across the rooftops

CG-04c.desc: Bonfire: Georgia and Brad, the raven mascot head in her lap

CG-04d.desc: Patricia in silhouette against the bonfire, glasses catching the flames, Brad beside her at a respectful distance

CG-05.desc: Grove Cafe after hours: the group around a faintly glowing pumpkin tart with a candle, everyone mid-confession

CG-06.desc: Patch 7 at golden hour: giant glowing pumpkins, Gord in silhouette holding a plank sign

CG-07.desc: Archive by flashlight: Brad holding the Pumpkin Research Program binder, a photo of three young people taped inside the cover

CG-08.desc: Lab loading dock: the van's open doors, Mr. Gourd in trench coat and mustache lifting a glowing pumpkin, one very stylish black heel showing under the coat

CG-09.desc: Great Hall under the full moon: the glowing punch bowl, jack-o'-lanterns aglow, the crowd mid-confession

CG-10a.desc: Jane ending: Jane and Brad with a lumpy snow pumpkin on the snowy farm, barn key in her hand

CG-10b.desc: Sandra ending: Sandra smiling fully at the trivia table, Brad beside her, the old photo and a new one behind the bar

CG-10c.desc: Georgia ending: Georgia and Brad at the cafe counter, the Honest Edition Pumpkin Surprise between them

CG-10d.desc: Patricia ending: Patricia at the farmhouse door in a trench coat and safety goggles, snow falling, Brad grinning

CG-11.desc: Flashback: the original Halloween dance 25 years ago, young Daniel, Gord and Eleanor under the program banner, glowing punch bowl in the foreground, Brad's mother in the crowd

CG-12.desc: Farm ending: Brad and Gord on the snowy porch, the crow on the railing, a carved glowing pumpkin between them

CG-13.desc: Good Friends ending: group photo on the tavern steps, Brad with all four, Gord, and the crow photobombing in the corner
